newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Applied Imaging started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Applied Imaging started.

text.p: -- Dillion, Read said analysts Raul Esquivel and Matthew Dodds initiated coverage of Applied Imaging Corp with a buy rating and a one-year price target of $14-$16 a share.
-- The company is in the final stages of developing a proprietary blood test to screen for chromosomal disorders such as Down's Syndrome, the analysts noted in a report.
-- The stock was not immediately trading after closing Friday at 6-5/8.
